records.title: feat(protocol): add typed command spec scaffold
records.release_claim: machine-facing command routes use one validated typed CommandSpec rather than parsing human display strings
records.reason: This is the foundational domain and path-confinement contract consumed by #2218 and #2223; omitting it makes their authority model impossible.
records.non_claim: A valid CommandSpec does not authorize or prove command execution.

records.title: docs(gate): define repair-route eligibility contract
records.release_claim: gate eligibility has one explicit producer-owned completeness and fail-closed contract
records.reason: The typed seam implementation and command-level blocking proof rely on this contract to distinguish complete, limited, stale, failed, unavailable, preview, advisory, and blocking evidence.
records.non_claim: The contract does not change default gate mode or make incomplete evidence block.
